title: 1. Overview
text: Purpose of the Saltmere POC: prove that an Agentforce member services agent on a Data 360 unified profile can answer claim-status questions and hand off to a human rep with a case summary. Business owner: Marisol Quintero. Sponsor: Priyanka Deshmukh.

title: 2. Scope and success criteria
text: In scope: the claim status journey for roughly 1.2M active members. Out of scope: eligibility changes and payments. Targets: at least 45% containment on status questions and a 20% handle-time reduction on escalated calls.

title: 3. Current-state landscape
text: Member data lives in the claims warehouse (managed cloud warehouse), the CRM (in-house) and the contact-center platform. No shared member key exists across the three. The partner estimates 6 to 8 weeks for batch ingest of the claims warehouse with change capture for the last 24 months.

title: 4. Target architecture
text: Batch ingest of the claims warehouse through the partner-built connector; CRM and contact-center platform through standard connectors; identity resolution with an exact and a fuzzy ruleset producing one unified individual per member.

title: 5. Identity and access
text: Staff users authenticate through the Saltmere IdP with SAML SSO; IdP groups map to Agentforce permission sets (see 5.2). Test members are synthetic records; no real member data enters the POC org.

text: Core DMOs: Individual, Contact Point Email, Contact Point Phone, Claim, Provider, Encounter. Claim status is read from the claim DMO; the agent never writes back to the warehouse.

title: 7. Rollout plan
text: TBD.

title: 8. Consumption model
text: Draft numbers pending from the specialist.

title: 9. Risks and assumptions
text: Risks: warehouse ingest schedule, SSO group mapping sign-off, availability of the 90-day contact-center export.

title: Order Status Agent

text: Confirm scope, sandbox access, pilot plan.

title: Predictive Maintenance Agent
text: Harrowgate Manufacturing: from sensor drift to a scheduled work order.

title: Unplanned downtime
text: Unplanned stops on the packaging lines cost more than scheduled maintenance windows.

title: Agent overview
text: The agent reads sensor trends, predicts failures and drafts a work order for the reliability lead to approve.

title: Failure prediction
text: Vibration and temperature features feed a model scored every 15 minutes.

title: Work order creation
text: Approved predictions create a work order with parts and a recommended window.
